pirs.statement: Will the Tidö coalition (M+KD+L with SD support) remain stable through June 2026?
Will the government's criminal justice legislative cluster (weapons law, prison expansion, youth offenders, police training) pass in May 2026 as scheduled?
Will Sweden's ratification of the international reparations commission (HD03231) and special tribunal (HD03232) for Ukraine proceed to successful Riksdag vote in May-June 2026?
Will Socialdemokraterna's coordinated six-interpellation campaign (infrastructure, sick-pay, corporate crime) produce measurable polling movement of ≥1.5pp by June 2026?
Will SD's challenge on energy policy escalate to coalition friction in May-June 2026?
Will the Södra stambanan infrastructure gap (HD10449) become a sustained electoral liability for the government coalition before September 2026?
Will Centre Party make a public coalition preference signal before summer 2026 that could reshape coalition formation assumptions?
Will the HD024099 motion (extending official liability beyond proposition 2025/26:217) produce JuU committee hearings or substantive amendments in May 2026?
